summary: Morpheus gathers everyone on the main deck and introduces Neo to the crew he doesn't know — Mouse, Cypher, Switch, Tank, and Dozer — then points out the Core, the hub where they "broadcast our pirate signal and hack into the Matrix." The space is described as a swamp of electronic equipment: coaxial vines, battery slabs, a satellite dish, monitors, and six ecto-skeleton chairs at the center. When Neo asks what the Matrix is, Morpheus directs him to the answer, touches the back of Neo's head, and orders Trinity to help him into a chair. Neo is seated and Morpheus feeds a coaxial line with a cerebrum chip into the jack at the back of Neo's neck, working a needle in through disturbing noises. Neo's body tenses, a loud CLICK fires and his ears pop, then he relaxes and opens his eyes as the scene pulls back into a weightless, other-place sensation.

what_changes.before: He still does not know what the Matrix is, and the names and faces "wash meaninglessly over Neo."
what_changes.after: Morpheus tells him the answer to what the Matrix is lies in the Core and in the connection being made to his own head: "You want to know what the Matrix is, Neo? The answer is right here."
what_changes.evidence: You want to know what the Matrix is, Neo?  The answer is right here.

what_changes.before: He is a passive observer being shown the ship, "Neo allows himself to be helped into one of the chairs."
what_changes.after: He is physically jacked into the network, his body reacting to the needle and click before his senses shift elsewhere: "a loud CLICK fires and his ears pop like when you equalize them underwater."
what_changes.evidence: He feels Morpheus guiding a coaxial line into the jack at the back of his neck.  The cable has the same kind of cerebrum chip we saw inside the plant.

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus introduces Neo to the crew and the Core, then jacks him into the Matrix for the first time to show him what it is.

objects_that_matter: coaxial line with a cerebrum chip
the jack at the back of Neo's neck
the control console and operator's station
uncertain: Whether Neo fully understands what is happening to him as he is jacked in.
What Neo experiences in the weightless "another place" his consciousness enters.

minds.wants: To finally get the answer to the question that has driven him — what the Matrix is.
minds.feels: Overwhelmed and disoriented. The names and faces 'wash meaninglessly over him'; he has no capacity to hold a crew in his mind because his entire being is consumed by the vertigo of the truth about the year and his own modified body (the ports he found in sc-037). He is not choosing to be jacked in so much as surrendering to it.
minds.shows: Passivity. He 'allows himself to be helped,' offers no resistance when the needle goes in, and endures the grimace silently until the click. He lets them read him as compliant.
minds.basis: The names wash over him meaninglessly; he lets Trinity seat him; he tolerates the needle and the disturbing noises. His question ('You want to know what the Matrix is') is the same hunger Morpheus has been deferring since the infirmary.

believes_about.belief: That Morpheus is about to give him a straight verbal answer, that the answer is a thing to be told.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus's 'The answer is right here' and the touch to the jack mean the answer will be experienced, not explained — a demonstration that will overwhelm him (ev-009).

minds.wants: To bring Neo to the threshold of knowing — not to tell him, but to make him undergo it.
minds.feels: A guided, almost ritual certainty. He has been promising 'the answers are coming' (sc-036) and deferring explanation in favor of showing (sc-037); here he is finally closing that debt. There is a deliberate, ceremonial quality to 'The answer is right here' and the touch.
minds.shows: Calm authority and showman's timing — he names the Core, names the crew, then pivots to the body. He softens the intrusion with 'This will feel a little weird,' understating what is clearly an invasive procedure.
minds.basis: His pattern of promising answers then showing instead; the theatrical staging of the Core reveal; the gentle minimization before the needle.

believes_about.belief: That Neo is ready — that the chosen one can take the truth.
believes_about.wrong_because: The next event has Neo's mind rejecting the overload; Morpheus will later admit he broke the rule against freeing older minds (ev-010), so his confidence here outruns the risk.

minds.wants: To get Neo into the chair safely and without fuss, on Morpheus's word.
minds.feels: Attentive and invested in him specifically — she has already singled him out with her smile. There is a protective ease in how she handles him.
minds.shows: A warm smile and nod to Neo, then competent physical help at Morpheus's order. Nothing that reads as more than crew loyalty to an observer.
minds.basis: She smiles and nods at him before anyone else is addressed; Morpheus singles her out ('Help him, Trinity') to do the intimate physical task.

believes_about.belief: That this newcomer is worth her personal care and faith.
believes_about.wrong_because: She cannot yet know what he will become; her belief is an intuition ahead of any evidence, which is precisely what makes it dramatic.

minds.who: The crew (Mouse, Cypher, Switch, Tank, Dozer)
minds.wants: To witness the new mind being brought in — to see what this 'one' is.
minds.feels: A watchful, uncommitted curiosity; they are named as a group and register as a presence rather than individuals, which is exactly how Neo experiences them.
minds.shows: Nothing legible — they stand and watch. Their blankness is not emptiness but reserve; they give Neo no welcome and no warning.
minds.basis: They are introduced only as names and faces that wash over Neo; the scene gives them no reaction, no line, no gesture.

connects_back: Neo's ports discovered in sc-037 make the jack at the base of the skull a known, feared thing now being used.
Morpheus's repeated deferral — 'the answers are coming' (sc-036), 'I can simply show it' (sc-037) — is finally paid off here.
The sleepwalker-state Neo enters in sc-038 carries into his passivity here; he is still being led, not acting.
sets_up: The jacking-in makes possible the Construct demonstration where the Matrix is shown to be a simulation (ev-008/ev-009).
The invasive needle and the 'another place' sensation foreshadow Neo's mind rejecting the overload of the truth (ev-009).
Establishes the physical ritual of jacking in that Tank will later formalize as Neo's operator (ev-011).
dramatic_function: This is the initiation threshold — it converts Neo's abstract hunger for truth into a physical, irreversible act, staging knowledge as something undergone rather than told, and moves him from passive questioner to an active participant being pulled into the world he asked about.
